subject: science
concept: Understanding DNA as the molecule that carries genetic information
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Life Science Disciplinary Core Ideas (Heredity) — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student builds a simple physical DNA double-helix model using base-pair pieces
exercise.pictorial: Student matches DNA base pairs correctly (A-T, C-G) on a labeled diagram
exercise.abstract: Student explains, in their own words, what DNA is and what it does

misconception_flags: pairs DNA bases incorrectly (e.g. A with C instead of A with T)

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
